description: 대구광역시_소방 긴급구조 재난관리정보 [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대구광역시. ‘재난관리정보’ 데이터는 대구시 긴급구조표준시스템에서 수집한 다차원적 재난대응 시나리오와 관리 계획이 요약된 자료입니다. Coverage: 대구광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 대구광역시. Its tags are 재난대응, 소방정보, 구조계획, 상황관리, 중점관리. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
